title: Third download: two hours of experiencing multiple timelines

tellings.quote: And it came to me at a place where my whole world shattered for two hours where I was experiencing multiple timelines really

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says that in the third of his "downloads", sudden floods of insight, his "whole world shattered for two hours" while he was "experiencing multiple timelines". He tells Michels this as something that happened to him.
